text.section: As used in this section, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Disabled veteran" means a veteran who has been found by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs or by the retirement board of one of the several branches of the armed forces to have a compensable service-connected permanent and total disability. "Veteran" has the same meaning ascribed to such term in § 2.2-2903.
An employer may grant preference in hiring and promotion to a veteran or the spouse of a disabled veteran.
Granting preference under subsection B does not violate any local or state equal employment opportunity law.
